object CarPlaySourceIdentity {
    const val sourceVersion="320.17"
    val userAgent get()="AirPlay/"+sourceVersion

    /** Wire compatibility declaration, NOT the Android OS build or an iOS identity.
     * Toyota libAirPlay's main/alt receiver compares this with "13A1" (0x1af74).
     * An unparsable Android Build.ID selects full-header AAD, but our established
     * HomeKit audio writers use timestamp+SSRC (RTP bytes 4..11), like 24A446.
     * 21A329 selects that modern branch (strictly newer than 13A1). Keep hardware,
     * osName and osVersion truthful; report the actual Android build in diagnostics.
     * This field can affect other receiver compatibility decisions as well. */
    const val compatibilityOsBuildVersion="21A329"

    fun setupDeviceFields(model:String,osVersion:String):Map<String,Any> = linkedMapOf(
        "model" to model,"osBuildVersion" to compatibilityOsBuildVersion,
        "osVersion" to osVersion,"osName" to "Android")
}

fun accessUnit(payload:ByteArray,key:ByteArray,sequence:Int,timestamp:Long,nonce:Long,type:Int):ByteArray {
        require(type in setOf(100,101,102))
        require(key.size==32&&sequence in 0..65535&&nonce>=0&&payload.isNotEmpty()&&payload.size<=1400)
        val pt=wireType(type)
        val header=ByteBuffer.allocate(12).order(ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN).put(0x80.toByte()).put(pt.toByte())
            .putShort(sequence.toShort()).putInt(timestamp.toInt()).putInt(0).array()
        val iv=Crypto.nonce(nonce)
        return header+Crypto.seal(key,iv,payload,header.copyOfRange(4,12))+iv.copyOfRange(4,12)

val initial=linkedMapOf<String,Any?>("deviceID" to options.phoneMac,"macAddress" to options.phoneMac,"name" to options.carPlayName)
        initial.putAll(CarPlaySourceIdentity.setupDeviceFields(Build.MODEL,Build.VERSION.RELEASE))
        initial.putAll(linkedMapOf(
            // A new textual UUID belongs to this control-session generation only.
            "sessionUUID" to java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString(),"sourceVersion" to CarPlaySourceIdentity.sourceVersion,"timingPort" to timing.localPort,
            "timingProtocol" to "NTP","isScreenMirroringSession" to false,"statsCollectionEnabled" to false,"features" to emptyList<Any>()))
        log("AirPlay identity osBuildVersion="+initial["osBuildVersion"]+" androidBuild="+Build.ID+
            " audioAAD=4-12; compatibility profile, actual device osName=Android osVersion="+Build.VERSION.RELEASE)

current_conclusions: Current osBuildVersion=21A329; model/osName/osVersion remain Android. Initial SETUP and /setup retry reuse the same encoded body. sourceVersion/User-Agent remain320.17.

Current main/alt output uses RTP[4,12) AAD for plain and RED packets. Compare(13A1,21A329)=-8 by the reviewed static formula, selecting the same modern Toyota receiver branch. The historical raw Android Build.ID mismatch is not present in these current source lines.

For this Toyota image, an unparsable second build supplied to Compare(13A1,build) selects legacy full RTP[0,12); equality13A1 also selects legacy. Actual previous device Build.ID comes from historical reports, not a new device read.

AirPlayReceiverSessionSetup: if minimum getter succeeds and Compare(minimum,current)>0, sets-6715, reports error, tears down and returns it. Getter failure branches past comparison. Minimum is config key clientOSBuildVersionMin, then synchronous property fallback; no concrete default/callback implementation or actual vehicle minimum is proven.

AirPlayCopyServerInfo: only clientBuild<18A0 takes legacy displays/viewAreas transformation; absent safeArea is filled from that view area's width/height/originX/originY. Current21A329 skips transformation. Current DisplayCapabilities selects only type,widthPixels,heightPixels,maxFPS,uuid. This shows observable behavior coupling, not a reproduced current video failure.

Current microphone input tries multiple authenticated layouts/AADs, including none, with chosen preferred but fallback still enabled every packet. It is local compatibility behavior, not proof of one fixed declared profile or iPhone equivalence. Failed authentication is not published.
